'''Smythe''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He owned a small shop on the [[Vaiken Spacedock]] where he bought, sold, and created artifacts and relics.
